paragraphs: Rabbi Yusti son of Rabbi Simon: [Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 6:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Eruvin.6.4.5).

Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Simon: [Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Maaser_Sheni.4.2.3). Levi bar Simon: [Chullin 141b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.141b.21).[^1]

notes.text: Bava Kamma names Rav Yehudah bar Simon. The two Jerusalem Talmud passages name Yusti and Yose with their respective patronymics. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2336&lang=en) records Levi bar Simon and the Chullin incident.
